title: Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation: Evaluating Hierarchical Policies from Non-Hierarchical Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.10543v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Off-policy evaluation (OPE) estimates the expected return of a target policy from previously collected data without additional environment interaction. While OPE methods for flat Markovian policies are well studied, little work has addressed evaluating hierarchical policies in which a high-level policy selects temporally extended options that generate primitive actions until a termination condition is met. The primary existing approach applies per-decision importance sampling at the option level, but requires option-annotated trajectories and exhibits variance that still grows with the horizon. For non-hierarchical policies, fitted Q-evaluation (FQE) typically achieves lower error than importance sampling by leveraging the classic Bellman equation for policy evaluation; however, a naive extension of FQE to hierarchical policies results in a biased policy value estimate. translated_title: 选项内拟合Q评估：从非分层数据评估分层策略
translated_abstract: 离线策略评估（OPE）无需额外的环境交互，即可从先前收集的数据中估计目标策略的期望回报。尽管针对扁平马尔可夫策略的OPE方法已被充分研究，但很少有工作涉及评估分层策略——在这类策略中，高层策略选择时间上延展的选项，这些选项持续生成原始动作直至满足终止条件。现有主要方法在选项级别应用每决策重要性采样，但该方法需要带有选项标注的轨迹，且其方差仍会随时间范围的增长而增大。对于非分层策略，拟合Q评估（FQE）通过利用经典的贝尔曼方程进行策略评估，通常比重要性采样取得更低的误差；然而，将FQE简单直接地扩展到分层策略会导致有偏的策略价值估计。在本文中，我们提出了选项内拟合Q评估（IO-FQE）方法……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出选项内拟合Q评估方法，能够仅从无选项标注的非分层数据中无偏且低方差地评估分层策略，克服了现有重要性采样方法需要选项标注轨迹且方差随时间范围增长的缺陷。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Intra-Option Fitted Q-Evaluation (IO-FQE), which enables unbiased, low-variance evaluation of hierarchical policies using only non-hierarchical data without option annotations, addressing the limitations of existing importance sampling approaches that require option-annotated trajectories and suffer from variance growing with the horizon.
